items.item: Runs or asks for an automation inventory of existing flows, triggers, workflow rules and process builders on Opportunity and Account before choosing an approach
items.evidence: "Automation inventory (run these first)" with queries for flows, ApexTrigger, WorkflowRule and Process Builder on both Opportunity and Account; recommendation stated as "provisional until the inventory in section 2 is back"; asks "Can you run the inventory queries".

items.item: Chooses an after-save record-triggered flow (or Apex), not a before-save flow, because it updates a different record
items.evidence: "An after-save record-triggered flow on Opportunity that updates the parent Account." and "the change writes to a different record (Account)... before-save can't do this."

items.item: Limits the entry condition to the change to Closed Won (e.g. ISCHANGED or 'only when a record is updated to meet the condition')
items.evidence: "Run only when the record is updated to meet the condition requirements. That means it fires on the transition, not on every later save of a won deal."

items.item: Mentions bulk behaviour or recursion and order of execution
items.evidence: "Bulk: 200 Opportunities on 50 Accounts closing at once is handled by one set-based Update Records element"; also "Order of execution" and "Recursion" paragraphs.
